scope: Every one of 368 decoded sprites in the supplied five-pack discovery index; does not certify all-game interface coverage.
review_method: All 12 source contact sheets visually inspected. All unique small sprites omitted from the contact sheets inspected in an enlarged in-memory montage. Exact image duplicates linked by SHA256. Direct archive read checked whether unlisted child slots were empty; source unchanged.
coordinate_convention: Regions are [x,y,width,height] in decoded sprite pixels. Full extents are exact image boundaries. Embedded portrait name regions are conservative bottom strips, not final replacement masks.
